bio.summary: Yann-Hang Lee is an Emeritus Professor in the School of Computing and Augmented Intelligence at Arizona State University. Lee received a PhD from the University of Michigan, an MS from Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute (1982) and a BS from National Cheng Kung University (1973). Lee was a research staff member at IBM Thomas J. Watson Research Center (1984-1988), then joined the University of Florida in 1988, and later served as program chair of the Computer Science and Engineering program at ASU (2008-2013). Research covers real-time computing, embedded systems, IoT, distributed systems and performance evaluation.
